cloud.title: Members Club login
cloud.description: Log in with the same account as the Washing Concierge app.

cloud_device.title: Select device
cloud_device.description: {count} device(s) registered to this account. Set a device IP if you use LAN.

lan.title: LAN direct connection
lan.description: Enter the UDP 50000 keys manually (obtain them via the app capture or a cloud login).

data.device_addr: Device IP address (optional, will be auto-discovered)

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Hitachi cloud service.
error.invalid_auth: Email address or password is incorrect.
error.no_devices: No devices are registered to this account.
error.invalid_hex: The key or IV is not a valid hexadecimal string of the expected length.
error.missing_members_key: MEMBERS_KEY / MEMBERS_IV is not configured. Enter the values extracted from the app APK (see README).

start.name: Start
start.description: Select a course and start. Leave "Delayed start" unchecked to start immediately.

course_no.name: Course
course_no.description: Course to run. The operation (wash / wash & dry / dry) is part of the course.

delay_minutes.name: Delayed start (N minutes later, optional)
delay_minutes.description: Reserve the start for N minutes from now. 1 hour later = 60, 3 hours later = 180. Max 1440 (24h). Some courses need a minimum lead time; too short will error.

device_id.name: Washer (optional)
device_id.description: Only when multiple washers are configured; pick one from the list.

marker.name: Reservation marker (advanced, optional)
marker.description: 4-digit hex of the minutes until start (0000 = now). Leave empty and use "Delayed start" instead.

entry_id.name: Config entry id (optional, YAML)
entry_id.description: Alternative to device_id (config entry id). Only when multiple washers are configured.

device_id.name: Washer (optional)
device_id.description: Only when multiple washers are configured; pick one from the list.

entry_id.name: Config entry id (optional, YAML)
entry_id.description: Alternative to device_id (config entry id). Only when multiple washers are configured.
